create_skyreels_v2_pipeline: create a SkyReelsV2Pipeline instance for text-to-video generation with T5 encoder and Wan VAE
run_text_to_video: run the SkyReelsV2Pipeline __call__ method to generate video frames from a text prompt
encode_prompt_t5: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with classifier-free guidance support
prepare_video_latents: prepare random Gaussian latents with correct temporal and spatial scaling for video generation
clean_text_prompts: clean and normalize text prompts using ftfy, HTML unescaping, and whitespace normalization
